welcome.title: ANTON Business
welcome.subtitle: Run sales, issue kvittos, optionally accept FTC.
welcome.bullet4: Connect a wallet later to accept FTC
welcome.footer: Everything stays on this device until you decide otherwise.

mode.title: How do you sell?
mode.subtitle: You can change this later. We use it to set up your default sale screen.
mode.simpleBody: Tap a price on the keypad, show a kvitto, done. Best for street stalls, kiosks, or one-product sales.
mode.extendedBody: Add items from a catalogue, automatic VAT breakdown across rates, optional discount. Best for cafés, restaurants, retail.

register.title: Business details
register.subtitle: These appear on every kvitto. Everything is stored locally on this device — no servers involved.

items.title: Add your items
items.subtitle: Add a few items to get started. You can edit, add more, or remove them later in Settings.
items.addStarterDesc: Drops in 6 sample items (Coffee, Tea, Bun, Sandwich, Beer, Wine) so you can try Extended mode immediately.
items.name: Name
items.addLater: You can add items later from Settings → Items.

done.title: You're set up
done.subtitle: Ready to issue your first kvitto.
done.nextBody: You can already issue kvittos and try the sale flow. To accept FTC payments via QR, head to Settings → Connect wallet when you're ready.

home.noWalletBody: You can issue kvittos, but customers can't pay with FTC yet. Go to Settings → Connect wallet.
home.extendedSaleBody: Cart with line items + VAT breakdown.

sale.customerScans: Customer scans with ANTON Communication to pay.
sale.connectWalletHint: Connect a wallet in Settings to show a payment QR.

extended.title: Extended sale
extended.noItemsHint: Add items in Settings → Items first, then come back here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.generateWalletHint: Generate a wallet to unlock FTC payment QRs in sale flows.
settings.backupOverdue: Bokföringslagen requires 7-year retention. Export your kvittos somewhere safe.
settings.backupNormal: Export your kvittos as CSV + HTML.

wallet.title: Connect wallet
wallet.generateDesc1: Generate a secp256k1 keypair on this device. The private key never leaves your phone — it lives in the device's secure keychain.
wallet.generateDesc2: Once connected, your Simple and Extended sales will show a payment QR for customers to scan with ANTON Communication.
wallet.walletExists: A wallet already exists on this device.
wallet.addressPublic: This is what customers scan to pay you. It's public — share freely.
